name: docs-preview-auto-sync
title: Automate Git-backed documentation preview updates
description: Implement Phase 1 of the approved docs editing roadmap: safe Git polling, fast-forward-only synchronization, cross-process build serialization, and automatic publication to the internal VitePress preview.
creator: wg
notes: Approved sequence: Git automatic preview updates, edit links and editor skeleton, draft save and preview, Git submission and review, then multi-user worktrees and Kooboo candidate automation. Phase 1 implementation and server credential verification are complete, including a CNB repository deployment token limited to repo-code read-only. The sync timer remains intentionally absent because local main is seven commits ahead of cnb/main and the working tree has 51 changed or untracked paths; do not replace the kbdev checkout until the current preview implementation has a safe Git baseline.
